widgets.label: toggle flight on
widgets.code:
local pc = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController()
local pawn = pc.Pawn
local movement = pawn.CharacterMovement

movement:SetMovementMode(5, 0) -- MOVE_Flying
movement.MaxFlySpeed = 1200

RegisterKeyBind(Key.UP_ARROW, function()
    local pc2 = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController()
    local pawn2 = pc2.Pawn
    local movement2 = pawn2.CharacterMovement
    local vel = movement2.Velocity
    movement2.Velocity = {X = vel.X, Y = vel.Y, Z = 500}
end)

RegisterKeyBind(Key.DOWN_ARROW, function()
    local pc2 = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController()
    local pawn2 = pc2.Pawn
    local movement2 = pawn2.CharacterMovement
    local vel = movement2.Velocity
    movement2.Velocity = {X = vel.X, Y = vel.Y, Z = -500}
end)

RegisterKeyBind(Key.SPACE, function()
    local pc2 = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController()
    local pawn2 = pc2.Pawn
    local movement2 = pawn2.CharacterMovement
    local vel = movement2.Velocity
    movement2.Velocity = {X = vel.X, Y = vel.Y, Z = 0}
end)

return "Flight enabled. UP_ARROW=up, DOWN_ARROW=down, SPACE=hover(stop)"

widgets.label: toggle flight off
widgets.code:
local pc = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController()
local pawn = pc.Pawn
local movement = pawn.CharacterMovement

movement:SetMovementMode(1, 0) -- MOVE_Walking

RegisterKeyBind(Key.UP_ARROW, function() end)
RegisterKeyBind(Key.DOWN_ARROW, function() end)
RegisterKeyBind(Key.SPACE, function() end)

return "Walking restored. UP_ARROW/DOWN_ARROW/SPACE set to no-op"
